title: CorporateActionEvent conceptual context
meaning: CorporateActionEvent is associated with event registration, suspension/bidding/lottery conditions, fees, issuance, status, documentation, meetings, tax, securities quantities, prices, exchange rate, claims, underlying security, modifications and class actions. Three distinct association lines connect the event and SecuritiesQuantity: SecuritiesQuantitySought, FractionalQuantity and an unlabelled line. Quantity also connects to election, which connects to protect processing. The figure shows no participant swimlane or business-message exchange direction.

title: Corporate-action services and entitlements
meaning: Mandatory and voluntary corporate actions specialize CorporateActionEvent; ChoiceCorporateAction specializes MandatoryCorporateAction. Cash and securities proceeds specialize ProceedsDefinition. Cash and securities entitlements specialize CorporateActionEntitlement. CorporateActionServicing links event, option servicing, account, notification, election, entitlement and distribution. Distribution links proceeds delivery; the delivery instruction connects securities-delivery and payment obligations. The outer unlabelled Event–SecuritiesQuantity association is retained, alongside the separate protect-process and securities-entitlement quantity associations.

title: CorporateActionOption attributes and proceeds
meaning: CorporateActionOption has directed attribute/type associations to charges/change/withdrawal indicators, currency and option code lists, feature and fraction-disposition code lists, offer type and option number. The source draws YesNoIndicator three times; the reconstruction retains three visible occurrences with one identical source label and package. Plain association links connect choice and proceeds. Cash and securities proceeds specialize ProceedsDefinition; securities proceeds link SecuritiesQuantity. The OfferTypeV2Code arrow is unlabelled in the artwork and remains so in the Mermaid graph.

title: Option-related corporate-action event, election and servicing
meaning: The option connects election, the valid action period, proceeds definition, servicing and distribution. Election connects protect processing and servicing. Protect processing and securities entitlement each have a separately named association with SecuritiesQuantity. The right-hand long association links CorporateActionEvent and CorporateActionServicing; its Event/Services endpoint labels are preserved. Mandatory/voluntary actions specialize Event; choice actions specialize MandatoryCorporateAction.
